title: Cover clear_target's refusal when an ancestor of the backup records cannot be inspected
outcome: Cover clear_target's refusal when an ancestor of the backup records cannot be inspected
acceptance: A test in the repository makes inspecting an ancestor of the backup records directory fail (a permission fixture or a nonprivileged subprocess), asserts backup_record_unreadable from show and clear with the records unchanged, and fails when an absence shortcut on the directory is reintroduced
